Haven’t checked oil in a while. Some selling pressure on the 4H, probably because Russian diesel is hitting the global market.  But diesel is just one oil product. It’s not crude oil—the stuff it all comes from.  With the Houthis stepping up attacks on Saudi…

🤔 Trading is hard because success often means doing things that feel backwards.

Things that go against what makes sense in a normal job or business. Even against our own nature.

Since we were kids, we’ve been told: do more, work harder, get better results.

So after a few stop-outs, we ask: what am I missing? What should I add or improve?

But we almost never ask: what can I remove or simplify? 👥

Maybe consistency comes from removing an indicator, not adding another one.

Making your entry checklist and rules simpler so you can make decisions faster.

Cleaning up your trading journal so filling it out doesn’t feel like homework.

Sometimes you’re not missing anything.

☝️You’ve just got too much shit getting in the way.
